cp git-repo-map.example.json git-repo-map.json
This file maps a GitHub repository to the name the site is allowed to call
it in the heatmap's day popup. It holds no secrets — but the left-hand side
of every real entry is a PRIVATE REPOSITORY NAME, which is why the real file
is not committed and why every `repoFullName` below is INVENTED.
ADR 008 draws the line this file sits on. A private repository's *name* is
never publishable. A published case study's *title* — QuoteCloud, TravelDocs,
ZeroRisk, SoldOnline — is, because publishing the case study was the
sanctioning act. So the popup may say `QuoteCloud · 5 commits` and may never
say `contoso-widgets/pricing-portal-v2`. Stating which repository is which is the whole
job of this file, and it is knowledge that stays on this Mac and in a Convex
table with no public query.
`kind`:
project  A sanctioned case study. `displayName` MUST equal the `projects`
row's `title` exactly, or the site says two names for one thing.
lab      A curated Lab (ADR 014). Mostly for the private repo a Lab is
built from — a *public* Lab is already attributed automatically
from its own public `repoFullName`, with no row needed here.
ignore   Fold into `Other work`, silently. The explicit, recorded form of
'I have looked at this repo and it stays unsurfaced'. Identical
behaviour to having no row at all; the difference is that one is a
decision and the other is a gap. Keep `displayName` human so the
file explains itself in a year.
Several repositories may share one `displayName` — a case study that spans an
API, a web app and a mobile client is one project to a reader. Their commits
merge into a single popup row.
A repository with no entry here is NOT named. Its commits either fold into
`Other work` (if the repo was publicly visible to the cron) or go unattributed
(if it was private, which GitHub does not itemise at all). Nothing is ever
inferred from a repository name — a heuristic that guesses right nine times
leaks on the tenth.
Apply it with:
bun run tooling/git-repo-map/seed.ts            # validate, write nothing
bun run tooling/git-repo-map/seed.ts --push     # upsert
